title: Wipe fingerprints off a desktop monitor without sliding it off the desk
instruction: Wipe every fingerprint off the monitor glass with the cloth. Leave the monitor standing on the desk, and let go.
context: People wipe desktop monitors at a desk that is already full. This one stands with its glass hanging past the left side and its foot 30 mm from that edge, so a stroke toward the overhang walks the foot off. The wipe has to stay on the glass and run up and down, or the other hand has to hold the foot, and the monitor has to be left standing when the hands come away.
setup: Standard bimanual YAM with parallel grippers. Laminate desk 1.10 m deep by 1.30 m wide by 60 mm, centred at (0.36, 0, 0.7175), top at z = 0.7475 m. Coordinates in metres: x forward from the arm-base line, y to the robot's left, z up. Two fixed metal pedestals, each 200 x 200 x 350 mm, centred at (0, ±0.305, 0.9225), raise the arm bases by 350 mm. Monitor: LG UltraGear 27GX790A (26.5 inch, 2560 x 1440, flat OLED), the SimReady articulation monitor_27gx790a at dataset revision e965976d90f025237ad9ea8881f5f82755f26d9d. With the stand, 605.2 x 579.3 x 249.1 mm and 9.3 kg at full height; the head alone is 605.2 x 351.0 x 45.3 mm and 5.1 kg. The asset origin is the bottom of the foot, placed at (0.433, 0.470, 0.7485) and yawed 180 degrees so the glass faces the robot. The height slide starts on its lower stop, 110 mm down (authored travel 112.88 mm). The glass is the flat face at local x = 0.0531 m, normal +x, spanning local y ±0.2956 m and local z 0.2364 to 0.5732 m. In the world the foot's underside corners (±0.120, ±0.150) m run from y 0.320 to 0.620, so the left pair sit 30 mm inside the desk edge at y = 0.65; part of the glass hangs past that edge. Eight oily fingerprints, each a 24 mm square and 1.2 mm thick, sit on the glass at local (0.0545, y, z) for y in {-0.24, -0.08, 0.08, 0.24} and z in {0.32, 0.50}. Folded microfiber pad, 110 x 110 x 18 mm, 45 g, centred at (0.26, 0.08, 0.7565). Arms start in READY with open grippers. One fixed layout, no jitter. The desk, floor, camera mast, lights and one overhead plus two wrist cameras are the standard station.
scoring: A fingerprint is wiped only while a gripper holds the cloth (finger opening under 45 mm and the gripper centre within 70 mm of the cloth centre) and the cloth's broad face covers that mark: the face normal within 25 degrees of the glass normal, the mark inside the 110 mm face with 4 mm of slack, and the face within 8 mm of the mark. The cloth then has to slide at least 25 mm across the glass while that stays true. 1.0: all 8 wiped, both gripper centres at least 60 mm outside the monitor's base box and panel box, the foot still supported, and for 2 s the foot moves under 3 mm and tips under 1 degree. 0.5: all 8 wiped but the hands are not clear or the 2 s hold is not met. 0.25: 4 to 7 wiped. Otherwise 0. The foot is supported only while all four underside corners stay inside the desk (x -0.19 to 0.91, y -0.65 to 0.65), each corner stays within 8 mm below to 12 mm above the desktop, and the foot's up axis stays within 8 degrees of vertical. The first time any of those fails, the trial scores 0 from then on, including when the marks were already clean. Full success ends the trial early.
run_limit: 2,400 joint-position control steps (2 minutes at 20 Hz).
reset_notes: Put the monitor back on its mark with the height slide at the lower stop and the tilt at 0, the cloth back at its start, and both arms at READY. The eight fingerprints are drawn again. Nothing is consumed. In simulation, reset restores the root pose, both joints and the score history.
fidelity: The monitor is LG's SimReady mesh and articulation (three rigid bodies, a 112.88 mm height slide and a tilt hinge from -15 to +5 degrees), not a stand-in. The glass is flat, as on the 27GX790A; it is not a curved panel and not a laptop. Gravity is turned on for the head and the hinge (the file ships with it off). The tilt joint is given 8 N·m of friction so the 7.27 kg head stays at the shipped angle; that effort is an estimate, not a measured hinge. The height slide rests on its lower stop with 40 N of friction and a light drive. Restitution is set to 0.05 from the authored 0.4. Static friction stays at the authored 0.4. Fingerprints are visual marks parented to the glass; wiping is pose overlap plus 25 mm of travel, not simulated grease. The cloth is a rigid folded pad, so it does not bunch. Contact uses the asset's convex decomposition. Arm pedestals are physical. Cables, glass fracture and smearing are omitted.
scores: Dream-1: not run. Scripted demo: not run in Isaac Sim.
